easy:mcq:1.stem: A line of best fit for a data set is $y = 3x + 10$. Use this model to predict $y$ when $x = 9$.

distractorNotes.A: The constant term was subtracted instead of added.
distractorNotes.C: The constant was added before multiplying by the slope.
distractorNotes.D: The slope and the intercept were swapped.

solution: Substitute 9 for $x$: $y = 3(9) + (10)$.
Evaluate the model: $y = 37$. This is a prediction, not necessarily an observed data value.

distractorNotes.B: An arithmetic slip: redo the last computation carefully.
distractorNotes.C: The slope and the intercept were swapped.
distractorNotes.D: The constant was added before multiplying by the slope.

solution: Substitute 3 for $x$: $y = 5(3) + (7)$.
Evaluate the model: $y = 22$. This is a prediction, not necessarily an observed data value.
